seoTitle: How to Add and Remove Strikethrough in Google Docs
metaDescription: Apply and remove strikethrough text in Google Docs using the Format menu or the Alt+Shift+5 / Command+Shift+X keyboard shortcut for faster editing.
intro: Strikethrough is a handy way to visually mark completed checklist items or track edits without deleting text outright. This guide covers applying strikethrough through the Format menu, using the keyboard shortcut for speed, and removing it cleanly once you're ready to finalize your document.

steps.heading: Select your text
steps.body: Highlight the block of text or specific sentence you want to strike through.

steps.heading: Open the Format menu
steps.body: Go to Format, then Text, to find the native Strikethrough command option.

steps.heading: Apply strikethrough
steps.body: Click Strikethrough to place a clean line directly through your selected text.

steps.heading: Use the keyboard shortcut
steps.body: Press Alt+Shift+5 on Windows/ChromeOS or Command+Shift+X on macOS to toggle strikethrough instantly without opening the menu.

steps.heading: Remove strikethrough
steps.body: Select the struck-through text and apply the same menu command or shortcut again to remove the formatting and restore normal text.

steps.heading: Use it for collaborative editing
steps.body: Apply strikethrough to track completed checklist items or flag content for removal during review, keeping the original text visible for context.

faq.question: Is there a faster way to apply strikethrough than the Format menu?
faq.answer: Yes, the keyboard shortcut Alt+Shift+5 on Windows/ChromeOS or Command+Shift+X on macOS toggles it instantly.

faq.question: Does strikethrough delete the text?
faq.answer: No, strikethrough only adds a visual line through the text; the original content remains fully intact and can be restored anytime.

faq.question: Can I use strikethrough alongside bold or italic formatting?
faq.answer: Yes, strikethrough can be combined with other text formatting like bold or italics without conflict.

faq.question: Will strikethrough text show up if I export to PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, strikethrough formatting is preserved when exporting to PDF or other standard document formats.
